archive_contract.sidecar_rule: The archive .sha256 sidecar must exist; --allow-missing-sidecar is forbidden for the G6 round trip.

assertions.requirement: manifest.sha256 equals SHA-256 of manifest.json bytes
every declared artifact and component payload hash re-verifies after restore

assertions.predicate: backend HYDRAULIC_SPATIAL_BACKEND == postgis|portable of the same run
assertions.requirement: restored hydraulic schema profile matches the gate profile that produced the archive

assertions.predicate: restore report checks.api_sse_smoke covers api and sse entries with status PASS
assertions.requirement: API and SSE smoke both succeed after the destructive restore

assertions.predicate: legacy characterization artifact from the same RUN_ID and commit is PASS
assertions.requirement: legacy API/SSE characterization shows zero regression

assertions.predicate: artifact exists under g6/<profile>/ and shares RUN_ID and commit with the other profile
assertions.requirement: restore evidence is profile-scoped and same-run

fail_closed_rules: A missing archive, manifest, sidecar, or payload is a failure, never a warning.
Hash drift between the pre-destroy verify and the post-restore verify is a failure.
Evidence from another RUN_ID or another commit is NOT evidence for this fixture.
A config-mode `docker compose config` run is not backup/restore evidence.

observed_results.note: Populated only by a real same-run G6 command; null here means NOT RUN.

profiles.independence_rule: Each profile runs its own command and writes its own evidence directory (g6/postgis, g6/portable); neither command may stand in for the other.
profiles.same_run_requirement: Both profile artifacts must share one RUN_ID and one commit.

restore_report.api_sse_smoke_rule: API smoke requires HTTP 2xx; SSE smoke additionally requires text/event-stream. Partial smoke (only one of --api-smoke-url / --sse-smoke-url) is a warning and therefore fails this G6 fixture.

statement: This file freezes the G6 backup -> destroy -> restore contract only. It declares required commands, manifest fields, and assertion predicates. It contains no observed restore hash, no measured latency, and no gate result; a value here is never execution evidence and cannot make G6 or AC-8 pass.
